alternatives.option: exec, falling through to the bundled server only when they die inside a grace window

context: Merged deep-review branch to main; fixed launcher exec-away-the-fallback bug that caused the field outage
rationale: exec replaced the shell so a registry-policy failure killed the launch outright, but a server that actually served and then exited must never be silently restarted because its client handshake is already spent; elapsed time is the only signal available without a pipe, which would break stdio passthrough
summary: Chose to run the network-dependent rungs (npx, npm-prefix, global) as child processes with an elapsed-time guard instead of exec, falling through to the bundled server only when they die inside a grace window
